newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-IPE Brent to move sideways to higher.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-IPE Brent to move sideways to higher.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
----------------- VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - June 16 -------------
+ Brent seen moving sideways to higher with first resistance
seen at $18.15
and then $18.50.
+ Some chartists warned that the long duration of the recent
range could
eventually make for a fairly dramatic breakout.
+ Gas oil was seen stuck in range with support around
resistance at $162.75.
IPE Brent futures were pipped to
move sideways to higher on Tuesday but most chartists expected any move to the upside to be shortlived.
August Brent closed 10 cents higher at $17.86 a barrel on Monday while gas oil ended $1.0 lower at $161.75 a tonne.
Steve Kwan at MMS in London said there was a good chance the August Brent contract could move higher but he added that any such move would be shortlived.

"The candlestick chart is dominated by black candles indicating that the market still isn't that confident," said Kwan. "However, momentum indicators are oversold which could signal a small upward correction."
He pinpointed upward targets of $18.15 and $18.50. Beyond, $18.50 he saw any ascent fizzling out.
"It won't get above $19," he said.

Analysts at MeesPierson were taking a cautious approach, scanning the technical horizon for rumblings of a possible break out of the $17.60ish to $18.15ish range which has hemmed the contract in over the past week.

"The increasing age of this range indicates a potentially violent move should it be exceeded and we are inclined to cut positions earlier than we otherwise might and join the market in holding back," they said in their daily energy report.
They said they would cover shorts around $17.72/76, but said the would cut positions if the August contract moved out of the $17.64 to $18.08 range.
They pegged support at $17.68, $17.60 and $17.35 and resistance at $17.88, $18.12 and $18.44.
Gas oil was expected to stay within the $160-$164 range.
MeesPierson pegged support at $161.50, $160.50 and $158.25 and resistance at $162.75, $164.00 and $164.75. _-- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
